primary_reference: Original Legger rider geometry, per author. Prototype is only a dimensional sensitivity check.
limits: Rigid two-link reach and local sampled centerline-to-surface proximity only. Capsule radii, palm/ankle offsets, pelvis anchor and bend planes are explicit analytical assumptions. Soft-tissue/seat contact, joint limits, wrist roll, clothing and live rider mesh/rig deformation are not solved. A negative radius-subtracted gap means nearby surface within the proxy radius, not a certified signed collision depth. Generated original is fused. Native source is never saved.
